mapper.sql: id, report_id, report_title, report_type, report_status, generation_mode, scope_type, scope_keywords, exclude_keywords, platform_scope, risk_levels, department_scope, monitor_task_ids, analysis_profile, template_id, event_id, period_start_time, period_end_time, report_summary, report_content, report_format, file_name, file_path, ai_model, ai_prompt_snapshot, generated_by, generate_time, archive_user_id, archive_time, archive_opinion, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_report ( report_id, report_title, report_type, report_status, generation_mode, scope_type, scope_keywords, exclude_keywords, platform_scope, risk_levels, department_scope, monitor_task_ids, analysis_profile, template_id, event_id, period_start_time, period_end_time, report_summary, report_content, report_format, file_name, file_path, ai_model, ai_prompt_snapshot, generated_by, generate_time, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{reportTitle}, #{reportType}, #{reportStatus}, #{generationMode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKeywords}, #{excludeKeywords}, #{platformScope}, #{riskLevels}, #{departmentScope}, #{monitorTaskIds}, #{analysisProfile}, #{templateId}, #{eventId}, #{periodStartTime}, #{periodEndTime}, #{reportSummary}, #{reportContent}, #{reportFormat}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{aiModel}, #{aiPromptSnapshot}, #{generatedBy}, #{generateTime}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_report SET report_status = 'archived', archive_opinion = #{archiveOpinion}, archive_user_id = #{archiveUserId}, archive_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campus_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
